description: Non-material amendment to planning permission 26/02465 (Variation of Condition 2 (Compliance with approved drawings) of planning permission PP/25/05358 (Variation of Condition 2 (Compliance with approved drawings) of planning permission PP/24/06181 for re-addition of required mechanical plant at roof level within an acoustic enclosure) to alter rear fenestration detailing, amendments to sunken garden and roof layout following internal alterations.) to regularise the Decision Notice for planning permission ref. PP/26/02465 so that it accurately records all conditions previously discharged under the earlier permissions, together with the application reference numbers; in particular correcting previously omitted Condition numbers 3, 8 and 13 from the list of discharged conditions and confirming the details for Condition numbers 4, 6 and 12.These amendments are administrative only and do not alter the approved development, drawings or scope of works.
